integrity: Complete proof and a standalone exact-convolution/reproducibility script are embedded; the finite tests supplement the analytic proof. No independent external verification has been performed.
limitations: Theorem is exact only for the six-point degree-two simplex and nonalias finite rectangular grids of side at least five; no other degree or shape is claimed. Bibliographic novelty remains best-knowledge.
title: Sharp unrestricted fourth Fourier moment on the six-mode quadratic simplex
